name: [🐲] MOUNT RNG
desc:
🎲 An RNG Game Focused on Rolling Unique Mounts, Exploring Islands, and Fighting Wild Beasts! 🎲

UPDATES EVERY 2 WEEKS!

🎃 UPDATE 54 IS HERE! 🎃

👥 Play with Friends: Receive a +5 Luck Boost for each friend playing with you! (This boost stacks!)
👍 Like the Game, Join the Group, and Turn on Notifications for an additional +20 Luck Boost!

🐴 There are currently more than 700 mounts available to roll in the game! New islands and mounts will be added in future updates!

⚠️ If you encounter any bugs, please report them on the group wall or in the server.

📅 Current Version: 1.54
